name: Bounded Path-Interval Families Are Cover-Recursive
statement: For $m\ge0$, let $\mathcal J_m$ consist of the empty set and every interval of length at most three in the path on $[m]$. Then $\mathcal J_m$ is cover-recursively peripheral.
proof: Induct on $m$. The concepts containing the last coordinate $m$ become $\varnothing$, $\{m-1\}$, and $\{m-2,m-1\}$ after deleting it, when defined, and all lie in the zero section. Thus the one-semicube is peripheral. Its contraction base is $\mathcal J_{m-1}$ and its duplicated site is a path on at most three vertices; both belong to the class.
